messages.author: 4587e4ded58851df
messages.subject: gmultmix and  formatting of obsCovs.
parts:
Hi all, 
Hope this finds you well. 
My issue seeking solution as follows:

I'm trying to fit models using gmultmix, however the formatting of obsCovs result in the following error when included in models:

Error in Xlam[rep(1:M, each = T), ] : subscript out of bounds  

Or

Error in model.frame.default(lamformula, siteCovs, na.action = NULL) : invalid type (list) for variable 'Day1'

#

Ad_FemaleNB <- unmarkedFrameGMM(y = RxJ_Female,

                                siteCovs = SiteCov_Female_34_28_06_23,

                                obsCovs = list(Day1 = Day_1),

                                numPrimary=1,

                                type = "removal")

 RxJ_Female = number of individuals at each site (rows) and trap occurrences (columns).

 Day_1 = a row for every site (679) and 5 columns (trap occurrences – 1 to 5 days) with column 1 having all ones in the column and columns 2 to 5 having zeros… this is a parameter to test trap shyness allowing day 1 to differ from 2-5.

 What are people's suggestions/solutions?

All the best

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: gmultmix and formatting of obsCovs.
parts:
Can you show what code you are using to actually run the models resulting in these errors?

Are you perhaps trying to use Day1 as a covariate on lambda? If it's in the obsCovs, you can only use it as a detection covariate (argument pformula).

Hi Ken, 

I was using multinomPois before which has (~ 1 ~ p ), but  gmultmix now uses (~  1 ~ 1 ~ p). 
 
so just a stupid mistake, this PhD haha. 

Thank you so much. 

All the best
Daniel
